title: High-dimensional censored MIDAS logistic regression for corporate survival forecasting
title_zh: 高维删失MIDAS逻辑回归在企业生存预测中的应用
title_primary: 高维删失MIDAS逻辑回归在企业生存预测中的应用
title_secondary: High-dimensional censored MIDAS logistic regression for corporate survival forecasting
authors: Wei Miao, Jad Beyhum, Jonas Striaukas, Ingrid Van Keilegom
official: 官方在线 2026-09-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper addresses the challenge of forecasting corporate distress, a problem marked by three key statistical hurdles: (i) right censoring, (ii) high-dimensional predictors, and (iii) mixed-frequency data. To overcome these complexities, we introduce a novel high-dimensional censored MIDAS (Mixed Data Sampling) logistic regression. Our approach handles censoring through inverse probability weighting and achieves accurate estimation with numerous mixed-frequency predictors by employing a sparse-group penalty. We establish finite-sample bounds for the estimation error, accounting for censoring, MIDAS approximation error, and heavy tails. For statistical inference, we develop a de-sparsified version of the proposed penalized estimator and establish its asymptotic theory, which enables valid statistical inference in high-dimensional settings with censoring. We show that censoring induces a nonstandard variance structure for the de-sparsified estimator, a feature that, to the best of our knowledge, has not been studied in the existing literature. The superior performance of the method is demonstrated through Monte Carlo simulations. Finally, we present an extensive application of our methodology to predict the financial distress of Chinese-listed firms and to identify covariates that are statistically significant for predicting distress. Our novel procedure is implemented in the R package Survivalml.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了企业困境预测这一挑战，该问题面临三个关键统计障碍：（i）右删失，（ii）高维预测变量，以及（iii）混合频率数据。为克服这些复杂性，我们引入了一种新颖的高维删失MIDAS（混合数据采样）逻辑回归模型。我们的方法通过逆概率加权处理删失问题，并利用稀疏组惩罚在众多混合频率预测变量下实现精确估计。我们建立了估计误差的有限样本界，同时考虑了删失、MIDAS近似误差和重尾分布。在统计推断方面，我们开发了所提惩罚估计量的去稀疏化版本，并建立了其渐近理论，从而在高维删失情境下实现有效的统计推断。我们证明，删失会诱导去稀疏化估计量产生非标准方差结构，据我们所知，这一特征在现有文献中尚未被研究。通过蒙特卡洛模拟展示了该方法优越的性能。最后，我们对该方法进行了广泛的应用，以预测中国上市公司的财务困境，并识别对预测困境具有统计显著性的协变量。我们的新程序已在R包Survivalml中实现。

title: Global pension asset allocations and debt markets
title_zh: 全球养老金资产配置与债务市场
title_primary: 全球养老金资产配置与债务市场
title_secondary: Global pension asset allocations and debt markets
authors: Ding Ding, Xiang Fang, Bryan Hardy, Karen K. Lewis
official: 官方在线 2026-09-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Pension funds have traditionally invested in global bond markets which offer predictable income and support stable portfolios. This column documents a recent shift in pension investing away from fixed-income securities and towards riskier and less liquid assets. A search for yield is an important reason for this change, along with the transition from defined benefit to defined contribution pension systems. This transformation presents opportunities for higher returns and more diversification, but also exposes bond markets and pension funds to more risk during volatile periods.
abstract_zh: 养老基金传统上投资于全球债券市场，这些市场提供可预测的收入并支持稳定的投资组合。本文记录了养老基金投资近期从固定收益证券转向风险更高、流动性较低的资产的趋势。追求收益是这一变化的重要原因，同时伴随着从固定收益型向固定缴款型养老金体系的转变。这一转型带来了更高回报和更多元化的机会，但也使债券市场和养老基金在波动时期面临更多风险。

title: DP19722 Child Penalties, Child Outcomes, and Family Culture
title_zh: 儿童惩罚、儿童结果与家庭文化
title_primary: 儿童惩罚、儿童结果与家庭文化
title_secondary: DP19722 Child Penalties, Child Outcomes, and Family Culture
authors: Eric Gould, Guy Lichtinger
official: 官方在线 2024-11-28 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper analyzes how the “child penalty” associated with career interruptions for women after becoming a mother is influenced by preferences absorbed during childhood, and how the child penalty, in turn, is related to the quantity and quality (education) of her own children. Using linked administrative data on Israeli parents and children, the analysis shows that mothers who grew up in larger and more traditional families marry men from larger families, and together they have more children. Growing up with more siblings is also associated with a larger child penalty for a mother in earnings and employment, as well as in terms of commuting less and moving to “mother friendly” firms at the expense of higher wage firms. The results also indicate that the child penalty produces two opposing effects on child human capital – a negative impact due to the loss of parental income, and a positive influence of increased maternal time away from work. Overall, the evidence suggests that the family preferences and norms absorbed during childhood significantly influence a woman’s choices of spouse, fertility, and child penalty later in life – but with little overall impact on her children’s high school achievements.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了女性成为母亲后因职业中断所面临的“子女惩罚”如何受到童年时期吸收的偏好影响，以及这种子女惩罚反过来又如何与其自身子女的数量和质量（教育）相关联。利用以色列父母及其子女的关联行政数据，分析显示，在较大且更传统的家庭中成长的母亲，会与来自较大家庭的男性结婚，并且他们共同生育更多子女。成长于有更多兄弟姐妹的环境，也与母亲在收入和就业方面的更大子女惩罚相关，同时还包括通勤减少以及转向“母亲友好”型企业而牺牲高薪企业的现象。结果还表明，子女惩罚对子女人力资本产生两种相反效应——因父母收入损失带来的负面影响，以及母亲减少工作时间增加陪伴时间的正面影响。总体而言，证据表明，童年时期吸收的家庭偏好和规范显著影响女性日后对配偶、生育及子女惩罚的选择——但对其子女的高中成绩总体影响甚微。

title: Disruptive Peers and Academic Performance: Short- and Long-Term Outcomes
title_zh: 干扰性同伴与学业表现：短期与长期结果
title_primary: 干扰性同伴与学业表现：短期与长期结果
title_secondary: Disruptive Peers and Academic Performance: Short- and Long-Term Outcomes
authors: Goulas, Sofoklis, Griselda, Silvia, Megalokonomou, Rigissa, Zenou, Yves
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: How do disruptive peers shape academic and career paths? We examine this question by leveraging the random assignment of students to classrooms in Greece and identifying the effects of peer disruptiveness on academic performance and career paths. Using suspension hours as a measure of disruptiveness, we find that students assigned to more disruptive classrooms have lower academic achievement, a higher risk of grade retention, and reduced likelihood of graduating from high school on time. They are also less likely to pursue competitive STEM fields or enroll in selective postsecondary programs. The adverse effects are more pronounced for students from low-income areas, in larger classrooms, or with fewer female peers. Using a lab-in-the-field experiment, we find that exposure to multiple disruptors, compared to just one, reduces students' study motivation, college aspirations, and readiness for science studies and careers, especially for those seated closer to disruptive peers.
abstract_zh: 破坏性同伴如何塑造学业与职业路径？我们利用希腊学生随机分配至班级的机制，考察同伴破坏性对学业表现及职业路径的影响。以停课小时数作为破坏性的衡量指标，我们发现，被分配至更具破坏性班级的学生，其学业成绩较低，留级风险更高，按时高中毕业的可能性降低。他们选择竞争激烈的STEM领域或进入选拔性高等教育项目的可能性也较小。不利影响在来自低收入地区、班级规模较大或女性同伴较少的学生中更为显著。通过一项实地实验，我们发现，与仅接触一名破坏者相比，接触多名破坏者会降低学生的学习动力、大学抱负及对科学学习和职业的准备程度，尤其是对座位靠近破坏性同伴的学生而言。

title: Heterogeneous Individual Valuations of a Mild Climate
title_zh: 异质性个体对温和气候的估值
title_primary: 异质性个体对温和气候的估值
title_secondary: Heterogeneous Individual Valuations of a Mild Climate
authors: Brueckner, Jan
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper explores heterogeneous individual valuations of an important amenity, climate mildness, using a traditional Rosen-Roback empirical framework. It does so by including interaction terms between the amenity and worker characteristics in an hedonic wage regression that also includes a housing-price measure. The results suggest that non-young workers (those in the mid-age and old groups) value a mild climate more than do young workers, matching the usual view that the tolerance for cold weather declines with age. The findings also suggest that, like their highly educated counterparts, workers with low education levels also highly value a mild climate, with workers in the middle range of education having a lower valuation. These findings, which contradict the view that only better-off individuals care about amenities, could reflect the lower burden in mild weather of the manual work done by the less educated. In addition to presenting these empirical findings, the paper further contributes by presenting new analytics for the Rosen-Roback model in a setting with individual heterogeneity.
abstract_zh: 本文运用传统的罗森-罗巴克实证框架，探讨了工人对一项重要宜居条件——气候温和度的异质性评价。通过在特征工资回归中加入该宜居条件与工人特征的交互项，并同时纳入房价指标，本文进行了分析。结果显示，非年轻工人（中年及老年群体）对温和气候的重视程度高于年轻工人，这与通常认为的耐寒能力随年龄增长而下降的观点相符。研究还发现，与高教育水平工人相似，低教育水平工人同样高度重视温和气候，而中等教育水平工人的评价则相对较低。这些发现与仅富裕人群关注宜居条件的观点相悖，可能反映了温和天气下低教育水平工人从事体力劳动负担较轻的情况。除呈现这些实证发现外，本文还通过在个体异质性情境下对罗森-罗巴克模型进行新的分析，进一步做出了贡献。

title: First-generation status as a criterion for affirmative action: Education and labour market effects of a tuition waiver in India
title_zh: 第一代身份作为平权行动的标准：印度学费减免的教育与劳动力市场效应
title_primary: 第一代身份作为平权行动的标准：印度学费减免的教育与劳动力市场效应
title_secondary: First-generation status as a criterion for affirmative action: Education and labour market effects of a tuition waiver in India
authors: Gopinath Annadurai, S. Sahoo
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We evaluate the First-Generation Graduate Scholarship scheme implemented in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu, which waives tuition fees for first-generation college students in technical education. The scheme represents a large-scale non-identity-based affirmative action policy in higher education, using first-generation status as the basis for eligibility. Using household survey data in difference-in-differences (DiD) and synthetic DiD frameworks, we find substantial improvements in enrollment, stream choice, and graduation in technical courses, with downstream effects on regular employment, occupational choices, and household welfare. Male students gained more than female students. The scheme also increased reliance on education loans to cover residual costs. The findings suggest that policies based on first-generation status can promote intergenerational mobility by expanding higher education access and improving labour market outcomes.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了印度泰米尔纳德邦实施的第一代研究生奖学金计划，该计划免除了技术教育中第一代大学生的学费。该计划代表了一项大规模的非身份认同为基础的平权行动政策，在高等教育中，以第一代身份作为资格依据。利用家庭调查数据，在双重差分（DiD）和合成双重差分框架下，我们发现技术课程的入学率、专业选择和毕业情况有了显著改善，并对正规就业、职业选择和家庭福利产生了下游影响。男性学生比女性学生获益更多。该计划还增加了对教育贷款的依赖，以覆盖剩余成本。研究结果表明，基于第一代身份的政策可以通过扩大高等教育入学机会和改善劳动力市场结果来促进代际流动性。

title: Free to Move? Immigration Liberalization and International Migration
title_zh: 自由流动？移民自由化与国际移民
title_primary: 自由流动？移民自由化与国际移民
title_secondary: Free to Move? Immigration Liberalization and International Migration
authors: Fabian Kuhn
official: 官方在线 2026-08-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines how immigration liberalization affects migrant inflows. We exploit Switzerland’s gradual introduction of free movement for European Union and European Free Trade Association nationals, while third-country nationals remained subject to a selective quota-based regime. Using administrative register data and a staggered difference-in-differences design, we find that free movement substantially increased immigration from affected countries, with the preferred specification implying that immigration more than doubled on average.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了移民自由化如何影响移民流入。我们利用瑞士逐步引入对欧盟及欧洲自由贸易联盟国家国民的自由流动政策，而第三国国民仍受制于基于配额的选择性制度。通过行政登记数据和交错双重差分设计，我们发现自由流动显著增加了来自受影响国家的移民，首选规格表明平均移民数量翻了一倍以上。

title: Childhood Health Shocks and the Intergenerational Transmission of Inequality
title_zh: 儿童健康冲击与不平等的代际传递
title_primary: 儿童健康冲击与不平等的代际传递
title_secondary: Childhood Health Shocks and the Intergenerational Transmission of Inequality
authors: Eriksen, Tine M., Gaulke, Amanda P., Svensson, Jannet, Skipper, Niels, Thingholm, Peter R.
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper documents a socioeconomic gradient in adult labor market penalties stemming from a single chronic and treatable childhood health shock in a country with universal access to healthcare. Using childhood onset Type 1 Diabetes, Danish administrative registry data, and causal forests, we estimate substantial variation in the employment and earnings penalties at age 30. These penalties vary systematically with parental income and maternal educational attainment. Our findings help explain the income-health gradient and have important implications for policy discussions related to the design of healthcare systems.
abstract_zh: 本文记录了在全民医保国家中，单一慢性且可治疗的儿童期健康冲击对成年劳动力市场惩罚的社会经济梯度。利用儿童期发病的1型糖尿病、丹麦行政登记数据及因果森林方法，我们估计出30岁时就业与收入惩罚存在显著差异。这些惩罚随父母收入及母亲教育程度呈现系统性变化。研究结果有助于解释收入-健康梯度现象，并对医疗体系设计相关的政策讨论具有重要启示。

title: The T-power of a majority under multi-winner scoring rules
title_zh: 多数在多胜者计分规则下的T权力
title_primary: 多数在多胜者计分规则下的T权力
title_secondary: The T-power of a majority under multi-winner scoring rules
authors: Muhammad Mahajne
official: 官方在线 2026-07-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In multi-winner elections, the goal is to select a pre-given size committee of members from a given set of candidates. We define the concept of T-power of a majority-group of voters (Total majority-power or Total tyranny-power) as the ability of the group to guarantee, under a given voting rule, that all the committee members belong to its favorite candidates, regardless of the preferences of the other voters. In this case, we say also that such a voting rule is exposed to T-power. This situation can be considered extreme and worrying in democracy. In this paper, we examine the T-power under classes of multi-winner scoring rules. We focus on some common rules, and it turns out that BLOC rule ( k - k -Approval) is totally exposed to T-power, that is, any majority-group of any size has T-power under this rule. On the other hand, CCR, k -Plurality and k -Inverse-Plurality rules are almost notexposed to it, that is, no majority of any size has T-power. These last rules may provide some protection for minority groups in the sense of preventing T-power.
abstract_zh: 在多赢家选举中，目标是从给定候选人集合中选出预先设定规模的委员会成员。我们定义多数选民群体的T-权力（总多数权力或总暴政权力）为：在给定投票规则下，该群体能够确保所有委员会成员均来自其偏好的候选人，而无论其他选民的偏好如何。在此情况下，我们也称该投票规则暴露于T-权力之下。这种情形在民主制度中可被视为极端且令人担忧。本文研究了多赢家计分规则类别下的T-权力。我们聚焦于若干常见规则，发现BLOC规则（k-k-批准制）完全暴露于T-权力，即任何规模的多数群体在此规则下均拥有T-权力。另一方面，CCR、k-复数制与k-逆复数制规则几乎不暴露于T-权力，即任何规模的多数群体均不拥有T-权力。这些规则在防止T-权力意义上可能为少数群体提供一定保护。

title: Free Banking with Tokenized Money
title_zh: 代币化货币下的自由银行体系
title_primary: 代币化货币下的自由银行体系
title_secondary: Free Banking with Tokenized Money
authors: Hans Gersbach, Sebastian Zelzner
official: 官方在线 2026-07-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study free banking with tokenized money and ask whether competition among private issuers can deliver efficient allocations in rollover economies with and without financial frictions. Issuers finance long-term investments by issuing par-redeemable, bearer-like tokens that must be rolled over at an intermediate date. In frictionless environments, Bertrand competition can implement the first-best, but the rollover channel depends on the competitive margin: competition in yields supports active secondary trade, whereas competition in issuance discounts forces issuer-managed rollover. When some issuers secretly abscond with funds, revealed absconding triggers default and exit, concentrating savings on surviving issuers and lowering aggregate rollover needs. This funds-concentration effect shifts equilibrium refinancing rates and redistributes returns across cohorts, so even investors who enter only after misconduct is revealed bear part of its consequences. Finally, we provide a new perspective on how regulatory restrictions on token remuneration can create inefficiency, instability, and potentially market breakdown.
abstract_zh: 本文研究代币化货币下的自由银行体系，探讨在存在与不存在金融摩擦的展期经济中，私人发行者之间的竞争能否实现有效配置。发行者通过发行以面值赎回、类似不记名形式的代币来为长期投资融资，这些代币必须在中间日期进行展期。在无摩擦环境中，伯特兰竞争可以实现最优配置，但展期渠道取决于竞争维度：收益率竞争支持活跃的二级市场交易，而发行折扣竞争则迫使发行者主导展期。当部分发行者秘密携款潜逃时，暴露的潜逃行为会引发违约和退出，从而将储蓄集中于幸存发行者，降低总体展期需求。这种资金集中效应会改变均衡再融资利率，并在不同代际间重新分配收益，因此即使在不当行为暴露后才进入市场的投资者也需承担部分后果。最后，本文为代币报酬的监管限制如何导致效率低下、不稳定乃至潜在市场崩溃提供了全新视角。

title: On the Effects of Monetary Policy Shocks on Income and Consumption Heterogeneity
title_zh: 货币政策冲击对收入与消费异质性影响的研究

authors: Chang, Minsu, Schorfheide, Frank
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Macroeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We use the functional autoregressive framework of Chang, Chen, and Schorfheide (2024) to examine the effects of monetary policy shocks on the cross-sectional distributions of U.S. earnings, consumption, and financial income. An expansionary shock reduces earnings inequality, primarily by moving individuals out of unemployment, increases consumption inequality, mainly through spending on durable goods, and raises financial income inequality. We further show how an internal instrument can be used to identify the central bank’s reaction function within a VAR framework.
abstract_zh: 我们采用Chang、Chen与Schorfheide（2024）的函数自回归框架，考察货币政策冲击对美国收入、消费及金融收入截面分布的影响。扩张性冲击通过推动个体脱离失业状态降低收入不平等，主要通过耐用品消费支出加剧消费不平等，并提升金融收入不平等。我们进一步论证了如何在VAR框架内利用内部工具变量识别中央银行的反应函数。

title_primary: 基于机器学习简约VAR模型的中国宏观金融关联性评估
title_secondary: Assessing Macrofinancial Linkages in China Using a Machine-Learned Parsimonious VAR Model
authors: Jin-Chuan Duan & Mr. Dimitrios Laliotis & Ms. Wei Sun
official: 官方在线 2026-06-26 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines macrofinancial linkages between property developers, financial institutions, and macroeconomic outcomes in China. Using a parsimonious vector autoregressive (VAR) model enabled by a machine learning algorithm, it quantifies how idiosyncratic shocks can propagate and be amplified across sectors, with potential implications for financial stability. Stress originating from privately owned developers and regionally focused financial institutions—though relatively limited in scale—can generate persistent spillovers through lending relationships, common exposures, shared markets, and changes in market sentiment. A decline in property prices may undermine investment, weaken consumer confidence, and adversely affect the health of both the property and financial sectors, thereby disrupting financial intermediation and weighing on broader economic growth. Policy considerations should take into account these feedback loops. Market- and exposure-based tools can be helpful for monitoring macrofinancial linkages and assessing the transmission of shocks.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了中国房地产开发商、金融机构与宏观经济结果之间的宏观金融关联。借助机器学习算法构建的简约向量自回归（VAR）模型，本文量化了异质性冲击如何通过部门间传导与放大，并对金融稳定产生潜在影响。源自私营开发商及区域性金融机构的压力——尽管规模相对有限——可通过信贷关系、共同风险敞口、共享市场及市场情绪变化，产生持续性的溢出效应。房价下跌可能削弱投资、打击消费者信心，并对房地产与金融部门的健康状况造成不利影响，进而扰乱金融中介功能，拖累整体经济增长。政策制定需充分考虑这些反馈循环。基于市场与风险敞口的工具，有助于监测宏观金融关联并评估冲击传导机制。

title: Trade Diversion and Jobs: Evidence from Mexican Municipalities
title_zh: 贸易转移与就业：来自墨西哥城市的证据
title_primary: 贸易转移与就业：来自墨西哥城市的证据
title_secondary: Trade Diversion and Jobs: Evidence from Mexican Municipalities
authors: Rodríguez-Castelán, Carlos, Vazquez, Emmanuel, Winkler, Hernan
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线月份 2026-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines the local effects of the 2018–19 U.S.-China trade disruptions on Mexico. Combining detailed municipal-level customs data with U.S. tariff schedules, it estimates that municipalities with greater export concentration in products targeted by U.S. tariffs on China (hereafter, tariff exposure) experienced significantly larger nearshoring dividends. An increase of 1 percent in tariff exposure led to a 4.3 percent increase in municipality-level exports to the United States, with gains concentrated in northern and south-central states. These export gains translated into broad labor market improvements: total labor income rose by 5.6 percent for each 1 percent increase in tariff exposure, driven by job creation rather than wage growth as average earnings remained unchanged. The effects were heterogeneous across skill levels, with the largest employment rate gains among semi-skilled workers. Beyond job quantity, the shock improved job quality: each 1 percent increase in tariff exposure reduced labor informality by 0.25 percentage points, with newly created jobs disproportionately being formal. Effects were driven primarily by manufacturing but extended to services through local spillovers. The findings indicate that trade policy changes between major economies can significantly reshape the spatial distribution of economic activity and the quantity and quality of jobs in third-party countries.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了2018-2019年中美贸易摩擦对墨西哥的本地影响。通过将市级海关数据与美国关税清单相结合，本文估算发现，在美国对华加征关税所针对的产品中（以下简称关税暴露度），出口集中度越高的城市，其获得的近岸外包红利显著更大。关税暴露度每增加1%，城市对美出口额增长4.3%，且增长集中在北部和中南部各州。这些出口增长转化为广泛的劳动力市场改善：关税暴露度每增加1%，劳动总收入增长5.6%，这一增长由就业创造驱动而非工资上涨，因为平均收入保持不变。不同技能水平的影响存在异质性，半熟练工人的就业率增幅最大。除就业数量外，冲击还提升了就业质量：关税暴露度每增加1%，非正规就业比例下降0.25个百分点，且新增就业岗位中正规就业占比显著更高。影响主要来自制造业，但通过本地溢出效应延伸至服务业。研究结果表明，主要经济体之间的贸易政策变化能够显著重塑第三方国家的经济活动空间分布以及就业数量与质量。

title: Extreme heat and household consumption: Evidence from China
title_zh: 极端高温与家庭消费：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 极端高温与家庭消费：来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Extreme heat and household consumption: Evidence from China
authors: Mengmeng Guo, Yixiang Yu
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-28 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper investigates the impact of extreme heat on household consumption using data from the 2013–2019 China Household Finance Survey. We find that extreme heat significantly suppresses total consumption, where each additional day of extreme high temperature leads to a 0.20% decline in total expenditures. This effect is more pronounced among rural, high-dependency-ratio, and credit-constrained households. Mechanism analyses reveal that extreme heat operates through two distinct channels: an income channel, whereby agricultural and labor earnings are reduced, and a risk channel, characterized by heightened risk aversion and increased precautionary savings. Crucially, we document a systematic budget reallocation within the household consumption basket. While subsistence spending remains rigid, defensive expenditures on healthcare and communication significantly increase, forcing households to sharply curtail discretionary and hedonic spending on entertainment, durables, tourism, and luxuries. These findings highlight how climate shocks degrade quality of life by shifting resources from welfare-enhancing to survival-oriented necessities.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2013-2019年中国家庭金融调查数据，考察极端高温对家庭消费的影响。研究发现，极端高温显著抑制了总消费，每增加一个极端高温日，总支出下降0.20%。这一效应在农村、高抚养比及信贷约束家庭中更为明显。机制分析表明，极端高温通过两条不同渠道发挥作用：一是收入渠道，即农业和劳动收入减少；二是风险渠道，表现为风险厌恶程度上升和预防性储蓄增加。尤为重要的是，本文揭示了家庭消费篮子内部的系统性预算再配置。在生存性支出保持刚性的同时，医疗和通信等防御性支出显著增加，迫使家庭大幅削减娱乐、耐用品、旅游和奢侈品等非必需及享乐性支出。这些发现凸显了气候冲击如何通过将资源从增进福利的消费转向生存导向的必需品，从而降低生活质量。

title: Fiscal sustainability in the world economy: evidence from panel and time-series analysis of 38 countries over half a century
title_zh: 世界经济中的财政可持续性：基于38个国家半个世纪面板与时间序列分析的证据
title_primary: 世界经济中的财政可持续性：基于38个国家半个世纪面板与时间序列分析的证据
title_secondary: Fiscal sustainability in the world economy: evidence from panel and time-series analysis of 38 countries over half a century
authors: Ricardo Ferraz
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Fiscal sustainability, closely linked to government solvency, is essential for public financing and, consequently, for ensuring the normal functioning of economic activity. In the context of rising global debt levels and higher borrowing costs, as recently highlighted by the International Monetary Fund, this paper examines the sustainability of fiscal policy across the world economy using a combination of estimation methods and tests. Adopting an approach that integrates panel data with time-series analysis for a sample of 38 countries over the past half-century, the initial conclusion is that global fiscal policy has been sustainable. However, a country-by-country analysis reveals a more nuanced reality. According to the ranking proposed in this paper, slightly more than two-thirds of the countries can be classified as exhibiting either unsustainable fiscal policies (Level C) or partial sustainability with potential risks (Level B) over the 1974–2023 period. The remainder of the sample shows evidence of fiscal sustainability (Level A); however, even within this level, the strength of this relationship varies considerably across countries, highlighting substantial heterogeneity in fiscal sustainability. By providing a comprehensive cross-country assessment based on a relatively long time series using rigorous applied techniques, this paper offers timely and policy-relevant insights for both academics and policymakers.
abstract_zh: 财政可持续性与政府偿付能力密切相关，是公共融资的基础，进而保障经济活动的正常运转。在全球债务水平攀升、借贷成本上升的背景下（国际货币基金组织近期已强调此问题），本文综合运用多种估计方法与检验手段，考察全球经济体的财政政策可持续性。通过将面板数据与时间序列分析相结合，对过去半个世纪38个国家的样本进行研究，初步结论显示全球财政政策总体具有可持续性。然而，国别分析揭示了更为复杂的现实。根据本文提出的分级体系，在1974-2023年期间，略超三分之二的国家可归类为不可持续的财政政策（C级）或存在潜在风险的局部可持续性（B级）。其余样本国家呈现财政可持续性证据（A级），但即便在这一层级内，各国可持续性关系的强度也存在显著差异，凸显财政可持续性的高度异质性。本文基于较长时序数据，运用严谨的应用技术方法提供全面的跨国评估，为学术界和政策制定者提供了具有时效性和政策参考价值的洞见。

title: The inefficiency of moderate political coercion: a cross-country comparison of coercion intensity, state legitimacy, and regime stability
title_zh: 温和政治胁迫的低效性：胁迫强度、国家合法性与政权稳定性的跨国比较
title_primary: 温和政治胁迫的低效性：胁迫强度、国家合法性与政权稳定性的跨国比较
title_secondary: The inefficiency of moderate political coercion: a cross-country comparison of coercion intensity, state legitimacy, and regime stability
authors: Øivind Schøyen, Espen Sirnes, Chris Rune Andersen
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Political coercion directed against non-state moralities can serve as a tool for generating legitimacy. Does the efficacy of political coercion in producing legitimacy vary with its intensity? Using Freedom House, V-Dem, and Polity5 indices as proxies for coercive intensity, together with data on regime legitimacy and survival, we find that a mid-level range of coercion is ineffective in generating legitimacy. Relatively few regimes operate in this intermediate zone, and those that do exhibit lower legitimacy and higher instability risks. In contrast, shifts away from this suboptimal range-toward either higher or lower coercion levels-correlate significantly with gains in legitimacy. Time-series analysis of authoritarian regimes reveals a recurring pattern: gradual reductions in coercion that drift into this inefficient mid-range, followed by sharp increases. This dynamic suggests that coercion carries substantial exogenous costs such as economic and reputational costs and that delayed feedback on its legitimacy effects produces overshooting. Drawing on historical cases such as the USSR, we argue that moderate coercion proves inefficient due to an intrinsic negative reaction to coercion, or coercion resentment.
abstract_zh: 针对非国家道德的政治强制可成为合法性生成的工具。政治强制在产生合法性方面的效力是否会随其强度变化？通过使用自由之家、V-Dem和Polity5指数作为强制强度的代理变量，结合政权合法性与存续数据，我们发现中等强度的强制区间无法有效生成合法性。相对较少的政权处于这一中间地带，而处于该区间的政权表现出较低的合法性和较高的不稳定风险。相反，偏离这一次优区间——无论是向更高还是更低强制水平移动——与合法性提升显著相关。对威权政权的时间序列分析揭示了一种反复出现的模式：逐步降低强制力度会滑入这一低效的中间区间，随后出现急剧的强制升级。这一动态表明，强制会带来显著的外生成本（如经济成本和声誉成本），而对其合法性效应的延迟反馈会导致过度调整。借鉴苏联等历史案例，我们认为，由于强制会引发内在的负面反应（即强制怨恨），温和的强制被证明是低效的。

title: Time domain estimation of non-fundamental ARMA models in the presence of heteroskedasticity of unknown form
title_zh: 异方差形式未知时非基础ARMA模型的时域估计
title_primary: 异方差形式未知时非基础ARMA模型的时域估计

authors: Ignacio N. Lobato, Carlos Velasco
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper considers time domain estimation of possibly non-fundamental (that is, non-causal and/or non-invertible) non-Gaussian linear ARMA models with martingale difference innovations that may display conditional heteroskedasticity of unknown form. Instead of explicitly parametrizing the underlying volatility process (the higher order dependence) and employing maximum likelihood procedures, we propose a time domain minimum distance objective function based on innovations predictability using second and third powers of past innovations. Using the proposed efficient GMM estimator, which is consistent and asymptotically normal, we estimate possibly non-fundamental ARMA models to inflation data from 29 OECD countries and find widespread evidence on non-fundamentalness.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在可能非基础（即非因果和/或非可逆）的非高斯线性ARMA模型中进行时域估计的问题，这些模型具有鞅差创新，可能表现出未知形式的条件异方差性。我们并未明确参数化潜在的波动率过程（高阶依赖性）并采用最大似然方法，而是提出了一种基于过去创新二次和三次幂的可预测性的时域最小距离目标函数。利用所提出的有效GMM估计量，该估计量具有一致性和渐近正态性，我们对29个OECD国家的通胀数据估计了可能非基础的ARMA模型，并发现了非基础性的广泛证据。

title: Female leadership, attractiveness, and corporate philanthropy
title_zh: 女性领导力、吸引力与企业慈善
title_primary: 女性领导力、吸引力与企业慈善
title_secondary: Female leadership, attractiveness, and corporate philanthropy
authors: Leng Ling, Danglun Luo, Wenhui Yang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: In societies with pronounced gender inequality, attractive women are often perceived as less competent leaders or confined to ornamental roles. Drawing on social role theory, institutional theory, and Upper Echelons theory, and integrating insights from research on gender inequality, beauty effects, and corporate philanthropy, we argue that attractive female CEOs strategically engage in philanthropy to counteract gender-based stereotypes, using such actions to signal compassion and social responsibility—qualities consistent with societal expectations of effective leadership. We further propose that the relationship between female CEO attractiveness and corporate philanthropy is moderated by contextual factors. Specifically, weaker gender stereotypes and more competitive markets that reward managerial talent should reduce the need for such compensatory behavior. Using data on Chinese firms, we examine the link between the physical attractiveness of female CEOs and corporate donations. The results show that attractive female CEOs engage more actively in philanthropy, contributing larger donations than their less attractive peers, particularly in regions with stronger gender stereotypes and less market-oriented economies.
abstract_zh: 在性别不平等显著的社会中，有吸引力的女性往往被视为能力较弱的领导者，或被局限于装饰性角色。借鉴社会角色理论、制度理论和高层梯队理论，并结合性别不平等、美貌效应及企业慈善领域的研究洞见，我们认为，有吸引力的女性CEO会策略性地参与慈善活动，以对抗基于性别的刻板印象，通过此类行为传递同情心与社会责任感——这些品质符合社会对有效领导力的期望。我们进一步提出，女性CEO吸引力与企业慈善之间的关系受到情境因素的调节。具体而言，较弱的性别刻板印象和更竞争激烈、奖励管理才能的市场，应会减少此类补偿性行为的必要性。利用中国企业数据，我们考察了女性CEO的外貌吸引力与企业捐赠之间的联系。结果显示，有吸引力的女性CEO更积极地参与慈善活动，其捐赠额高于外貌吸引力较低的同行，尤其是在性别刻板印象较强且市场化程度较低的地区。

title: How judges’ social identity impacts reversal decisions: evidence from the transitory promotion of judges
title_zh: 法官社会身份对改判决策的影响：基于法官临时晋升的证据
title_primary: 法官社会身份对改判决策的影响：基于法官临时晋升的证据
title_secondary: How judges’ social identity impacts reversal decisions: evidence from the transitory promotion of judges
authors: Patrick C Wu, Chang-Ching Lin, Yun-chien Chang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Several studies have underscored the significance of familiarity and collegiality in shaping judicial behavior in US federal courts. However, the distinct features of the US judicial system limit the ability to formulate a general theory. This research draws on 84,335 appellate decisions from Taiwanese courts to examine the role of familiarity in a career judge system. In Taiwan, lower court judges are transitorily promoted to appellate courts for 3 years, after which they typically return to their district courts before some of them are permanently promoted. By comparing their reversal patterns during temporary and subsequent permanent promotions to those of permanent appellate judges, we find that transitorily promoted judges reverse less frequently, and judges generally favor district courts where they have previously served. Social identity is likely a key explanatory factor. The size, diversity, and random allocation of cases in our dataset strengthens the generality of judicial behavior theories.
abstract_zh: 多项研究强调了熟悉度与同僚关系在美国联邦法院司法行为中的重要性。然而，美国司法体系的独特性限制了构建普适性理论的能力。本研究基于台湾法院的84,335份上诉判决，探讨职业法官体系中熟悉度的作用。在台湾，地方法院法官会临时晋升至上诉法院任职三年，之后通常返回原审法院，其中部分法官最终获得永久晋升。通过比较这些法官在临时晋升与后续永久晋升期间与常任上诉法官的改判模式，我们发现：临时晋升法官的改判频率较低，且法官普遍倾向于偏袒其曾任职的地方法院。社会认同可能是关键解释因素。本数据集在规模、多样性及案件随机分配方面的优势，增强了司法行为理论的普适性。

title: Information disclosure and questionnaires in public tenders
title_zh: 公开招标中的信息披露与问卷调查
title_primary: 公开招标中的信息披露与问卷调查
title_secondary: Information disclosure and questionnaires in public tenders
authors: Thomas Greve, Hans Keiding
official: 官方在线 2026-05-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Public tenders typically involve uncertainty and unforeseen costs, which might not be fully known to the bidders themselves. This uncertainty may also concern adaptation costs to the procurer after the delivery, and information about such adaptation costs may influence the bidding strategies, even though the cost is paid by the procurer. Consequently, the availability of information matters, and if it is obtained by the procurer, withholding information from bidders may be better than sharing all of it. To investigate the methods of gathering information, we consider pre‐qualification stage questionnaires designed to obtain information from the bidders. If suitably designed, they can be used to disclose information of which the bidders are themselves unaware and can thereby serve as a tool for revealing the inherent tendency of the cost for the bidders, so that the unforeseen future cost can be estimated.
abstract_zh: 公开招标通常涉及不确定性和不可预见的成本，投标人自身可能无法完全了解这些成本。这种不确定性还可能涉及交付后采购方的适应成本，尽管该成本由采购方承担，但有关此类适应成本的信息仍可能影响投标策略。因此，信息的可获得性至关重要。若采购方掌握了信息，对投标人隐瞒信息可能比完全共享更优。为探究信息收集方法，我们考虑在资格预审阶段设计问卷，以获取投标人的信息。若设计得当，此类问卷可用于披露投标人自身尚未意识到的信息，从而成为揭示投标人成本内在趋势的工具，进而对不可预见的未来成本进行估算。

title: Can Women Benefit From Household Land Titles? Evidence From Nigeria
title_zh: 女性能否从家庭土地所有权中受益？来自尼日利亚的证据
title_primary: 女性能否从家庭土地所有权中受益？来自尼日利亚的证据
title_secondary: Can Women Benefit From Household Land Titles? Evidence From Nigeria
authors: Fang Xia, Klaus Deininger, Xuwen Gao
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-04-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Formal land titling is recognised as a mechanism to reduce gender disparities in land rights. However, many interventions adopt gender‐neutral, low‐cost designs aimed at ensuring equitable access. Despite technological advances reducing titling costs, effective registry maintenance still imposes significant regulatory and institutional preconditions. This study explores the gender implications of a voluntary, cost‐bearing land registration process for title holders, implemented without explicit gender inclusion requirements. Using nationally representative data from Nigeria's Living Standards Measurement Surveys‐Integrated Surveys on Agriculture and an instrumental variable approach that leverages historical global crop prices weighted by predetermined local crop composition, we investigate how land titles held by household members impact women's land rights, labour market participation and intrahousehold bargaining power. Our results show that while titling strengthens bequest rights for both genders, it notably enhances women's inheritance rights by 64%–66%. Additionally, titling doubles women's wage labour participation without affecting men's engagement and boosts women's control over liquid wealth, as indicated by a 42%–43% increase in bank account access. These findings suggest that an on‐demand titling system, even without explicit gender inclusion requirements, can significantly reduce gender disparities by securing women's land access and reallocating labour to productive activities.
abstract_zh: 摘要 正式的土地所有权认证被视为减少土地权利性别差异的一种机制。然而，许多干预措施采用性别中立、低成本的方案，旨在确保公平获取。尽管技术进步降低了确权成本，但有效的登记册维护仍需要严格的监管和制度前提。本研究探讨了一项自愿、费用承担的土地登记程序对产权持有者的性别影响，该程序在实施时未包含明确的性别包容要求。利用尼日利亚生活水平测量调查—农业综合调查的全国代表性数据，以及一种工具变量方法，该方法利用按预定地方作物构成加权后的历史全球作物价格，我们研究了家庭成员持有的土地所有权如何影响女性的土地权利、劳动力市场参与及家庭内部议价能力。结果显示，虽然土地确权增强了男女双方的继承权，但显著提升了女性的继承权，增幅达64%–66%。此外，土地确权使女性工资性劳动参与率翻倍，而不影响男性的参与，并增强了女性对流动财富的控制，表现为银行账户访问率提高42%–43%。这些发现表明，即使没有明确的性别包容要求，按需确权制度也能通过保障女性土地获取并将劳动力重新配置到生产性活动中，显著减少性别差异。

title: Free market initiatives: Benefits and distortions from political power
title_zh: 自由市场倡议：政治权力的收益与扭曲
title_primary: 自由市场倡议：政治权力的收益与扭曲
title_secondary: Free market initiatives: Benefits and distortions from political power
authors: Qi Zhang, Bin Zhao
official: 官方在线 2026-04-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines the effects of China's Free Trade Zone (FTZ) initiative on firm performance and how these effects vary by firms' political power. Using a staggered difference-in-differences design in two settings, we find that FTZ implementation increases return on assets, total factor productivity, and exports. These gains are larger for state-owned and politically connected firms, especially in productivity. Mechanism analyses suggest that politically advantaged firms benefit more from lower effective tax rates and reduced financial expenses. The findings show that political power distorts the gains from market liberalization and limits equal access to reform opportunities.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了中国自由贸易试验区（FTZ）政策对企业绩效的影响，以及这些影响如何因企业的政治权力而异。通过采用两阶段交错双重差分设计，我们发现自贸区实施提高了资产回报率、全要素生产率和出口水平。这些收益在国有企业和具有政治关联的企业中更为显著，尤其是在生产率方面。机制分析表明，具有政治优势的企业从较低的实际税率和减少的财务费用中获益更多。研究结果显示，政治权力扭曲了市场自由化的收益，并限制了平等获取改革机会的途径。

title: Patent pool formation between rival standards
title_zh: 竞争标准间的专利池形成
title_primary: 竞争标准间的专利池形成
title_secondary: Patent pool formation between rival standards
authors: Takaaki Abe, Emiko Fukuda, Shigeo Muto
official: 官方在线 2026-03-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper extends the Cournot–Shapiro model to provide a tractable model of voluntary patent pool formation among standard essential patent holders. We assume that patent holders have complementary patents for a standard. We first show that the existence of a path of voluntary patent pool formation heavily depends on demand for patent licenses and that no such path exists in linear demand examples. Next, we extend our model to consist of two rival standards that are substitutable and compete à la Bertrand competition. We show that while a large patent pool benefits both patent holders and licensees, it is not provided voluntarily. Our analysis suggests that the presence of a rival standard may facilitate voluntary patent pool formation.
abstract_zh: 本文扩展了古诺-夏皮罗模型，构建了一个可处理的标准必要专利持有人自愿组建专利池模型。我们假设专利持有人拥有互补性标准专利。首先证明，自愿组建专利池路径的存在性高度依赖于专利许可需求，在线性需求示例中不存在此类路径。其次，将模型扩展至包含两个可替代且进行伯川德竞争的标准。研究表明，尽管大型专利池对专利持有人和被许可方均有利，但该专利池无法通过自愿方式形成。我们的分析表明，竞争性标准的存在可能促进自愿专利池的组建。

title: Have We Misunderstood Copyright?
title_zh: 我们误解了版权吗？
title_primary: 我们误解了版权吗？
title_secondary: Have We Misunderstood Copyright?
authors: Stan J. Liebowitz
official: 官方在线 2026-01-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper uses a quasi‐experimental design, a unique dataset of physical books, and a sample of vintage former bestsellers to examine copyright's impact on price, sales, and availability in the book market. We find that copyright increases sales, raises price, especially for top‐selling titles, and increases the number of old titles being sold in the market. These findings challenge the traditional access/incentive tradeoff and the view that society benefits when titles enter the public domain. Policy implications include reconsideration of uniform copyright terms and exploration of renewal‐based systems that allow rights holders to self‐select into extended protection.
abstract_zh: 本文采用准实验设计、独特的实体书籍数据集以及一批经典旧版畅销书样本，考察版权对图书市场价格、销量及可获得性的影响。研究发现，版权提升了销量，提高了价格，尤其是对畅销书而言，并增加了市场上旧版书籍的销售数量。这些发现挑战了传统的获取/激励权衡观念，以及认为作品进入公共领域对社会有益的观点。政策启示包括重新考虑统一的版权期限，并探索基于续展的制度，使权利持有人能够自主选择延长保护。

title: Shock Propagation within Multisector Firms
title_zh: 多部门企业内部的冲击传导
title_primary: 多部门企业内部的冲击传导
title_secondary: Shock Propagation within Multisector Firms
authors: JAY HYUN, ZIHO PARK, VLADIMIR SMIRNYAGIN
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2025-11-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies the role of multisector firms in the cross‐sectoral propagation of economic shocks. By leveraging an increase in import competition from China as a source of a negative economic shock, we show that employment of an establishment in a given industry is negatively affected by shocks that impact establishments operating in other industries within the same firm. We explore a range of explanations for our findings, emphasizing the role of within‐firm input–output linkages and within‐firm diversification across sectors. At the sectoral level, shocks that propagate through firms' internal networks have a sizable impact on industry‐level employment dynamics.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了多部门企业在经济冲击跨部门传导中的作用。通过利用来自中国的进口竞争加剧作为负面经济冲击的来源，我们表明，某一行业内企业的就业会受到同一企业内其他行业运营企业所受冲击的负面影响。我们探讨了多种解释我们发现的可能原因，强调了企业内部投入产出联系和跨部门多元化所扮演的角色。在部门层面，通过企业内部网络传导的冲击对行业层面的就业动态产生了显著影响。

title: Achieving sustainable development and debt sustainability in developing countries: to what extent do debt-for-nature swaps matter?
title_zh: 发展中国家实现可持续发展与债务可持续性：债务自然互换的作用有多大？
title_primary: 发展中国家实现可持续发展与债务可持续性：债务自然互换的作用有多大？
title_secondary: Achieving sustainable development and debt sustainability in developing countries: to what extent do debt-for-nature swaps matter?
authors: Yacouba Coulibaly Université d’Orléans, LEO, Orléans, France
official: 官方在线 2025-07-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper assesses the impact of debt-for-nature swaps on sustainable development in developing countries, using entropy balancing on a large sample of 127 countries from 1990 to 2020. The findings indicate that debt-for-nature swaps have a positive and statistically significant effect on sustainable development, operating through several key channels: public debt reduction, increased public investment, lower CO2 emissions, and improved human development. The additional results found in this paper show that if treated countries had not benefited from debt-for-nature swaps, their sustainable development index would have decreased by 11%. At the same time, if untreated countries had benefited from debt-for-nature swaps, their sustainable development index would have increased by around 2%. The analysis also reveals a non-linear relationship between the size of debt-for-nature swaps and the sustainable development index, with an optimal threshold estimated at 42% of the public debt level, beyond which diminishing returns are observed. These results suggest that debt-for-nature swaps can serve as an effective financing tool for sustainable development, provided that they are appropriately designed. From a policy perspective, expanding debt-for-nature swap programs requires broadening eligibility criteria, strengthening transparency and governance of environmental funds, and more systematically integrating climate objectives into multilateral debt relief mechanisms. Enhanced coordination between public and private creditors, as well as environmental organizations, is also crucial to ensure that debt-for-nature swaps support the ecological transition effectively in the most vulnerable countries.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了债务换自然互换对发展中国家可持续发展的影响，采用熵平衡方法，基于1990年至2020年间127个国家的广泛样本进行分析。研究发现，债务换自然互换对可持续发展具有正向且统计显著的影响，其作用机制主要通过几个关键渠道实现：公共债务减少、公共投资增加、二氧化碳排放降低以及人类发展水平提升。本文的额外结果显示，若受处理国家未受益于债务换自然互换，其可持续发展指数将下降11%；同时，若未受处理国家受益于债务换自然互换，其可持续发展指数将上升约2%。分析还揭示了债务换自然互换规模与可持续发展指数之间的非线性关系，估计最优阈值为公共债务水平的42%，超过此阈值则观察到边际收益递减。这些结果表明，债务换自然互换可作为可持续发展的有效融资工具，前提是其设计得当。从政策角度看，扩大债务换自然互换项目需要拓宽资格标准、加强环境基金的透明度与治理，并更系统地将气候目标纳入多边债务减免机制。加强公共与私人债权人以及环境组织之间的协调，对于确保债务换自然互换在最脆弱国家有效支持生态转型也至关重要。

title: Measuring the characteristics and employment dynamics of U.S. inventors
title_zh: 美国发明者特征与就业动态的测度
title_primary: 美国发明者特征与就业动态的测度
title_secondary: Measuring the characteristics and employment dynamics of U.S. inventors
authors: Ufuk Akcigit, Nathan Goldschlag
official: 官方在线 2025-03-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Innovation is a key driver of long-run economic growth. Studying innovation requires a clear view of the characteristics and behavior of the individuals who create new ideas. A general lack of rich, large-scale data has constrained such analyses. We address this by introducing a new dataset linking patent inventors to survey, census, and administrative microdata at the U.S. Census Bureau. We use this data to provide a first look at the demographic characteristics, employer characteristics, earnings, and employment dynamics of inventors. These linkages, which will be available to researchers with approved access, dramatically increase the scope of what can be learned about inventors and innovative activity.
abstract_zh: 创新是长期经济增长的关键驱动力。研究创新需要清晰了解创造新思想的个体的特征与行为。然而，丰富的大规模数据普遍缺乏，制约了此类分析。为解决这一问题，我们引入了一个新数据集，将专利发明人与美国人口普查局的调查、人口普查及行政微观数据相连接。利用这些数据，我们首次揭示了发明人的人口统计特征、雇主特征、收入及就业动态。这些数据链接（经批准访问的研究人员可使用）将极大拓展对发明人及创新活动的认知范围。此为订阅内容预览，请通过机构登录以确认访问权限。

title: Does Monitoring Change Teacher Pedagogy and Student Outcomes?
title_zh: 监督是否改变了教师教学法和学生成果？
title_primary: 监督是否改变了教师教学法和学生成果？
title_secondary: Does Monitoring Change Teacher Pedagogy and Student Outcomes?
authors: Aaron Phipps
official: 官方在线 2024-10-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In theory, monitoring can improve employee motivation and effort, particularly in settings lacking measurable outputs, but research assessing monitoring as a motivator is limited to laboratory settings. To address this gap, I leverage exogenous variation in the presence and intensity of teacher monitoring, in the form of unannounced in-class observations as part of DC public schools’ IMPACT program. As monitoring intensifies, teachers use more individualized teaching and emphasize higher-level learning. When teachers are unmonitored, their students have lower test scores and increased suspensions. This evidence validates monitoring as a potential tool for enhancing teacher pedagogy and employee performance more broadly.
abstract_zh: 理论上，监督能够提升员工的积极性和努力程度，尤其在缺乏可量化产出的环境中，但关于监督作为激励因素的研究目前仅限于实验室环境。为填补这一空白，我利用华盛顿特区公立学校IMPACT项目中未事先通知的课堂观察作为教师监督存在及强度的外生变异。随着监督加强，教师更倾向于采用个性化教学并强调更高层次的学习。当教师不受监督时，其学生的考试成绩下降，停学事件增多。这一证据证实了监督作为提升教师教学方法及更广泛员工绩效的潜在工具的有效性。
